description: For event types with `repeatMax` (from get_public_profile): lists each meeting of a series that starts at `start` (one of the slots) and repeats `every` 1, 2 or 4 weeks at the same local time, and whether each is free. Book it with create_booking and `repeat` when `bookable` is true. A series is booked whole or not at all, and round robin gives every meeting to the same host.

anyOf.description: how many meetings, first included (2 up to the event type's repeatMax)
anyOf.title: between(2, 52)

anyOf.description: a string to be decoded into a number
a string to be decoded into a number

handle.description: a handle, the first part of a booking link ("acme" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

slug.description: an event type slug from get_public_profile ("demo" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

start.description: one of the `slots` values from get_available_slots, as given (ISO in UTC)

name: check_series
title: Check a repeating series before booking it
